standard_prerequisites.use: Morphisms of thickenings of algebraic spaces, surjective etale charts, etale localness of properties of morphisms, sheaves of differentials, and the definition of properness. The chart reduction and the case analysis are retained.

core_obligations: Reduce the whole list to the schemes case by choosing surjective etale charts V' over Y' and U' over X' x_{Y'} V' and using etale localness of the properties.

Discharge the items not covered by the blanket reduction, including the equivalence Omega_{X/Y} = 0 iff Omega_{X'/Y'} = 0 and the properness case via quasi-compactness, universal closedness, separability and local finite type.

difficulty_reason: For a morphism (f, f') of thickenings of algebraic spaces over S with f and f' locally of finite type and X = Y x_{Y'} X', nine separate properties are shown to hold for f exactly when they hold for f'. The proof reduces the whole list at once to the schemes case: it chooses a scheme V' etale over Y', takes U' etale over X' x_{Y'} V', sets V = Y x_{Y'} V' and U = X x_{X'} U', and observes that etale local properties of morphisms may be checked on this chart, which puts the schemes version of the lemma in reach. The remaining work is a case-by-case discharge of the items not covered by the blanket reduction, including the differential comparison Omega_{X/Y} = 0 and the properness case, which uses the characterisation of properness as quasi-compact, universally closed, separated and locally of finite type. The chart reduction is what makes one proof serve nine statements, and the case analysis for (4) and (8) is not covered by it. Retained author proof at lines 2173-2247.
